sample_unit: model-generated responses (450 expert rating records from 5 orthopaedic clinicians)
unlisted_practices: Blinded expert clinician rating of LLM responses to patient-facing post-ACL reconstruction rehabilitation questions for accuracy, safety, stage-fit, completeness, and understandability
